programs.name: sukill
programs.purpose: Zero selected traces by trace number or header value.

params.name: min
params.description: One-based first trace to zero; a positive value selects trace-number mode.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of traces to zero in trace-number mode.

params.name: key
params.description: Header used to select traces when min is zero.

params.name: a
params.description: Header value identifying traces to zero.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Header selection compares the converted double value exactly against a. In trace-number mode, the first selected trace's sample count is reused for subsequent selected traces.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program selects traces and zeros their samples. This inventory is incomplete: the other 15 requested programs have not been fully verified.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sukill min=2 count=3

test_cases.description: Zero traces selected by a header value.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sukill key=tracl a=4

programs.name: sumixgathers
programs.purpose: Combine two gather files, retaining traces from the first file when offsets match.

params.name: ntr
params.default: computed: from the first input trace's ntr header
params.description: Allocation size for the first gather; required when its ntr header is zero.

params.name: scaling
params.description: If nonzero, scale unmatched traces from the second file by an offset-dependent factor.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Offset matching uses asymmetric floating-point tolerances, and optional scaling mixes float samples with double constants before assignment. The offset array can overflow if ntr is smaller than the first file's actual trace count.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers one gather and compares each trace of the second gather against its offsets.

test_cases.command: susorty nt=64 nshot=1 noff=4 doff=20 > in1.su && susorty nt=64 nshot=1 noff=6 doff=10 > in2.su && sumixgathers in1.su in2.su ntr=4 scaling=0

test_cases.description: Scale unmatched traces from the second gather.
test_cases.command: susorty nt=64 nshot=1 noff=3 doff=1000 > in1.su && susorty nt=64 nshot=1 noff=5 doff=500 > in2.su && sumixgathers in1.su in2.su ntr=3 scaling=1

programs.name: susorty
programs.purpose: Generate a small shot-ordered trace set whose samples show acquisition geometry.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSORTY - make a small 2-D common shot off-end

params.name: noff
params.description: Number of offsets per shot; the selfdoc says 20, but the code uses 24.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Geometry is calculated as float and converted to integer header fields; dt is converted to microseconds. The tracl formula uses ishot*nshot rather than ishot*noff.
programs.difficulty_reason: It generates trace headers and fills four sample ranges with geometry values.

test_cases.command: susorty nt=64 nshot=3 noff=4 dt=0.002 dshot=10 doff=20

test_cases.description: Exercise fractional geometry and a sample count not divisible by four.
test_cases.command: susorty nt=65 nshot=2 noff=3 dt=0.001 dshot=12.5 doff=7.5
